name: requirements-workbench
description: Turn software ideas into selectable, traceable, independently revisable requirements artefacts.

interface.shortDescription: Turn software ideas into reviewable requirements artefacts.
interface.longDescription: Requirements Workbench supports first-time contributors and experienced analysts. It explains unresolved questions in plain language, then produces traceable requirements, fishbone, context, use-case, activity, and wireframe modules that can be revised independently.
defaultPrompt: Turn my software idea into clear, reviewable requirements.
Analyse stakeholder notes and generate traceable artefacts.
Revise one requirements module without changing the others.
